run_multilingual_training: run the XLM multilingual transformer training loop with CLM MLM AE MT and BT steps
build_argument_parser: build an argparse parser with model data batch and training hyperparameters for language transfer experiments
run_encoder_only_training: run a single encoder training pipeline using SingleTrainer and SingleEvaluator for monolingual tasks
run_enc_dec_training: run an encoder-decoder training pipeline using EncDecTrainer for machine translation and back-translation tasks
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only mode to compute BLEU perplexity and other metrics without training
